title: Properties panel: sound settings for active frame (loop count, in/out points, effect)
description: The Properties panel has no sound section. SoundLinkage.repeatCount, effect, customEnvelope, inPoint, and outPoint all exist in the model and work in the SoundPanel, but Flash 8 places these in the context-sensitive Properties panel for the selected frame. Add a sound subsection to PropertiesPanel.tsx that appears when the selected frame has a sound assigned.
